aou_req__fault_lib__fault_ids.content:
The integrator shall give the faults of a component's catalog IDs that are unique within that catalog and
shall use only ASCII in text fault IDs and environment data.
aou_req__fault_lib__fault_ids.title: Fault IDs

aou_req__fault_manager__single_instance.content:
The integrator shall run one diagnostic fault manager per system and give it the fault catalogs of all
fault libraries that report to it.
aou_req__fault_manager__single_instance.title: Single Fault Manager

aou_req__sovd_gateway__trusted_network.content:
The integrator shall make the SOVD gateway reachable only from trusted clients, and each upstream SOVD server
reachable only from the gateway, as a lock taken on an upstream server directly would not be held on the other
servers of the vehicle. The gateway connects to the upstream without TLS.
aou_req__sovd_gateway__trusted_network.title: Trusted Network

aou_req__uds_data_bridge__handler_contra.content:
The user shall provide ``ReadDataByIdentifier`` handlers that return their future without blocking and
stop their work when the stop token is requested.
aou_req__uds_data_bridge__handler_contra.title: Cooperative UDS Handlers

comp_req__cda__http_server_port.content: The classic diagnostic adapter shall fulfil :need:`req~sovd-api-http-server-port`.
comp_req__cda__http_server_port.title: CDA HTTP Server Port

comp_req__fault_lib__catalog.content:
The fault library shall let a component define its faults in a fault catalog, given as JSON or in code, and
shall refuse a catalog that defines a fault ID twice.
comp_req__fault_lib__catalog.title: Component Fault Catalog

comp_req__fault_lib__debounce.content:
The fault library shall debounce reports per fault before relaying them, with a policy configured in the
fault catalog: a minimum count within a time window, a hold time, or an edge with a cooldown.
comp_req__fault_lib__debounce.title: Debouncing

comp_req__fault_lib__enabling_conditions.content:
The fault library shall let a component report the status of an enabling condition and let fault monitors
query it.
comp_req__fault_lib__enabling_conditions.title: Enabling Conditions

comp_req__fault_lib__framework_agnostic.content: The fault library shall be usable from synchronous code without an async runtime and from several threads.
comp_req__fault_lib__framework_agnostic.title: Framework Agnostic

comp_req__fault_lib__relay.content:
The fault library shall relay report to the diagnostic fault manager over IPC. A report whose send fails
with a transient error (transport down, timeout, queue full or rate limited) shall be kept in a retry queue of
512 reports, which drops the oldest report when full. Each report shall be retried up to 10 times, with the
delay doubling from 100 ms up to 5 s, and shall be dropped after the tenth failed attempt. A report whose send
fails with any other error shall be dropped at once. A successful send counts as relayed; the fault library
does not wait for an acknowledgement from the fault manager.
comp_req__fault_lib__relay.title: Relay to the Fault Manager

comp_req__fault_lib__report_errors.content:
The fault library shall return an error to the reporting component when a report cannot be relayed or
queued.
comp_req__fault_lib__report_errors.title: Reporting Errors

comp_req__fault_lib__reporting.content:
The fault library shall let a component report a fault of its catalog with its lifecycle stage, the time of
the report and optional environment data, through a reporter bound once to the fault's descriptor.
comp_req__fault_lib__reporting.title: Fault Reporting

comp_req__fault_manager__aging.content:
The diagnostic fault manager shall reset a fault that no longer occurs by the policy of its catalog entry:
after a number of power cycles or named operation cycles, after a stable time, or only on request of a
tester.
comp_req__fault_manager__aging.title: Aging

comp_req__fault_manager__catalog_aggrega.content:
The diagnostic fault manager shall be configured with the fault catalogs of all fault libraries and shall
keep the faults of different catalogs apart, also when they use the same fault ID.
comp_req__fault_manager__catalog_aggrega.title: Catalog Aggregation

comp_req__fault_manager__env_data.content:
The diagnostic fault manager shall store the environment data reported with a fault together with its
status.
comp_req__fault_manager__env_data.title: Environment Data

comp_req__fault_manager__persistence.content:
The diagnostic fault manager shall store the status, the environment data, the occurrence counters and the
timestamps of all faults persistently, so that they survive a restart, and shall remove the stored data of
faults that are deleted.
comp_req__fault_manager__persistence.title: Persistence

comp_req__fault_manager__queries.content:
The diagnostic fault manager shall answer the SOVD server's queries for the faults of a catalog and their
environment data, and shall delete faults on its request, scoped to that catalog.
comp_req__fault_manager__queries.title: Fault Queries

comp_req__fault_manager__status.content:
The diagnostic fault manager shall keep the status of every fault of its catalogs, derived from the
reports of the fault libraries, including faults that were never reported.
comp_req__fault_manager__status.title: Fault Status

comp_req__sovd_gateway__discovery_timeou.content:
When its upstream SOVD server does not answer a discovery request within 5 s, the SOVD gateway shall list
the entities it hosts; forwarded requests other than discovery shall have no time limit.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__discovery_timeou.title: Discovery Time Limit

comp_req__sovd_gateway__dot_segments.content:
The SOVD gateway shall not forward a request whose path contains a ``.`` or ``..`` segment, also
percent-encoded.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__dot_segments.title: Dot Segments

comp_req__sovd_gateway__forwarded_auth.content:
When authentication is enabled in the SOVD gateway, it shall validate the access token of every request before
forwarding the request to an upstream SOVD server, and shall not forward a request whose token is not valid.
The v1.0 gateway does not enable authentication, so this requirement is not part of v1.0.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__forwarded_auth.title: Authentication Before Forwarding

comp_req__sovd_gateway__forwarding.content:
The SOVD gateway shall forward requests for entities it does not host, and for locks, functions and
collections, to its upstream SOVD server, and shall return the upstream's status, headers and body to the client.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__forwarding.title: Forwarding to the Upstream

comp_req__sovd_gateway__hosted_entities.content:
The SOVD gateway shall host the S-CORE platform as a component and every application registered in its
process as an app of that component, and shall answer requests below these entities itself, without
forwarding them.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__hosted_entities.title: Hosted Entities

comp_req__sovd_gateway__merged_discovery.content: The SOVD gateway shall list the entities of its upstream SOVD server together with the entities it hosts.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__merged_discovery.title: Combined Discovery

comp_req__sovd_gateway__reference_rewrit.content:
The SOVD gateway shall replace references to the API of its upstream SOVD server in forwarded responses,
in the ``Location`` header and in JSON bodies, with references to its own API.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__reference_rewrit.title: No Upstream References

comp_req__sovd_gateway__single_entry_poi.content:
The SOVD gateway shall serve the entities it hosts and the entities of its upstream SOVD servers under one
SOVD API base URL.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__single_entry_poi.title: Single Entry Point

comp_req__sovd_gateway__upstream_config.content:
The SOVD gateway shall take its listen URL from ``SOVD_URL`` and the base URLs of its upstream SOVD servers
from the comma-separated ``SOVD_UPSTREAM_URL``. Each upstream shall use an ``http://`` URL or a Unix domain
socket URL of the form ``unix:<socket>[:<base path>]``, for example
``unix:///run/cda.sock:/vehicle/v15``. The gateway shall refuse to start with an invalid upstream URL and
shall forward nothing when ``SOVD_UPSTREAM_URL`` is unset or empty and no upstream is supplied on the command
line.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__upstream_config.title: Upstream Configuration

comp_req__sovd_gateway__upstream_unavail.content:
While its upstream SOVD server is unreachable, the SOVD gateway shall keep serving the entities it hosts
and shall answer forwarded requests with HTTP 502 and an error that contains no upstream address.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__upstream_unavail.title: Unavailable Upstream

comp_req__sovd_gateway__vehicle_lock.content:
The SOVD gateway shall acquire a lock of the whole vehicle from every SOVD server of the vehicle, its upstream
SOVD servers and the SOVD server within the gateway itself, answer it with a lock ID of its own, and keep track
of the lock until it is released. When an upstream refuses, the SOVD gateway shall send a release for the parts
it acquired and answer the refusal. A release shall be sent to all servers holding a part of the lock at the same
time, and a part that is already released shall not make a repeated release fail. If a part cannot be released,
the SOVD gateway shall answer with that failure. The lock is then held only on the servers that still hold a part of it, until the
client repeats the release or the upstream lock expires. The rollback after a refused acquisition is best-effort
in the same way.
comp_req__sovd_gateway__vehicle_lock.title: Vehicle Lock

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__non_blocking_.content: Pending reads of UDS handlers shall not delay the handling of other requests by the SOVD gateway.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__non_blocking_.title: Non-Blocking Reads

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__nrc_errors.content:
The UDS data bridge shall answer a read whose UDS handler returns NRC 0x31 (requestOutOfRange) as not found,
and shall include the NRC in the error of every other negative response.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__nrc_errors.title: Negative Response Codes

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__octet_stream_.content:
For data resources, the UDS data bridge shall return the UDS payload as ``application/octet-stream`` when the
HTTP Accept header of the request asks for it.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__octet_stream_.title: Binary Data Values

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__read_admissio.content:
The UDS data bridge shall answer a read with an error, without calling the UDS handler, while eight reads of
that handler are outstanding.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__read_admissio.title: Read Admission

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__read_handlers.content:
The UDS data bridge shall provide read-only data resources whose values are read from C++
``ReadDataByIdentifier`` handlers of ``score::mw::diag``.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__read_handlers.title: Data from UDS Handlers

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__read_timeout.content:
The UDS data bridge shall answer a read with an error when its UDS handler does not complete within the
timeout configured for the data resource, and shall request the handler to stop.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__read_timeout.title: Read Timeout

comp_req__uds_data_bridge__utf8_data.content:
For data resources declared as text, the UDS data bridge shall return the UDS payload as a JSON string and
shall return an error instead of a value when the payload is not valid UTF-8.
comp_req__uds_data_bridge__utf8_data.title: Text Data Values

stkh_req__docgen_enabled__example.rationale: Ensure documentation builds are possible for all modules
stkh_req__docgen_enabled__example.title: Example Functional Requirement

arch.description: Mapping of uml key to uml content.

constraints.description: List of constraint names, which are defined for this need.

constraints_error.description: An error message set if any constraint failed, and `error_message` field is set in config.

constraints_passed.description: True if all constraints passed, False if any failed, None if not yet checked.

constraints_results.description: Mapping of constraint name, to check name, to result, None if not yet checked.

content.description: The main content of the need.

docname.description: Name of the document where the need is defined (None if external).

doctype.description: The markup type of the content, denoted by the suffix of the source file, e.g. '.rst'.

external_css.description: CSS class name, added to the external reference.

external_url.description: URL of the need, if it is an external need.

has_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list.

has_forbidden_dead_links.description: True if any links reference need ids that are not found in the need list, and the link type does not allow dead links.

is_external.description: If true, no node is created and need is referencing external url.

is_import.description: If true, the need was derived from an import.

is_modified.description: Whether the need was modified by needextend.

jinja_content.description: Whether the content was pre-processed by jinja.

layout.description: Key of the layout, which is used to render the need.

lineno.description: Line number where the need is defined (None if external).

parts.description: Mapping of parts, a.k.a. sub-needs, IDs to data that overrides the need's data

post_template.description: The template key, if the post_content was created from a jinja template.

pre_template.description: The template key, if the pre_content was created from a jinja template.

signature.description: Derived from a docutils desc_name node.

style.description: Comma-separated list of CSS classes (all appended by `needs_style_`).

template.description: The template key, if the content was created from a jinja template.
